comment: Next-best-product scores (Opportunity Identification, mv_next_best_product): the propensity (0-1) of each golden client to buy each recommended product, its rank among the client's top-3 recommendations, the three main drivers, the expected annual revenue and the model version, for the month-ends Apr-Sep 2026 (model NBP-3.1). is_latest_score_month marks Sep-2026, the current scores. Propensity is a score: average it or rank by it, never sum it; expected revenue is additive within one score month. Grain: one row per golden client x product x score month.
